Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
6:30 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor. Those matter more than a fancy screen or a graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB minimum, and pick one you can upgrade later.
Processor: Ryzen 5 or 7, or Intel Core i5 or Ultra 5 or newer, for smooth builds and many tabs open.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more.
Screen and keyboard: a bright 1080p screen (IPS or OLED) and a keyboard you like typing on for hours.
Battery: 8 hours or more of real use, if you work away from a plug.

Skip gaming laptops unless you also train AI or play games. They cost more, run hot and have poor battery life.

Do you mostly write websites and apps, or do you also run AI or heavy tools? Tell me that, and whether you prefer Windows, Linux or Mac, and I can look up current options in your budget.
